q2_gaps: NP-internal locative PP whose object is a linear route rather than a container ("a train station on the line Siliguri -- Katihar"): the instruction set gives LocatedIn for containment ("in" examples only), a surface-preposition head for entity-attached "from", and PartOf for a component of an object, but no rule for choosing among them for an entity-attached "on"-PP
notes: The kind word standing beside the name ("the line Siliguri -- Katihar") is handled by the prescribed ordinary type atom plus one Name, have takes Holder/Theme, and train_station carries its station genus with the noun modifier correctly left unexposed. LocatedIn is the only defined static locative head, so the choice is within the letter of the instructions even though the surface preposition is "on".
